description: This file contains action creators and utility functions for inviting members and guests to channels and teams in Mattermost, including handling email invites and error cases.

methods.name: sendMembersInvites
methods.description: Sends invites to members via team ID, user profiles, and emails, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: sendGuestInviteForUser
methods.description: Invites a guest user to a team and channels, checking existing membership and adding as needed.

methods.name: sendGuestsInvites
methods.description: Sends invites to guest users and emails for specified channels, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: sendMembersInvitesToChannels
methods.description: Sends invites to members and emails to channels, including preloading team members and handling errors.
